QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] A Shortcut to Souvenirs
QuestInfo.0: Just as you were about to head off to round up a bag full of the coolest souvenirs for CONY, you saw Cassandra looking like she has something she wants to say. You should talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Just as you were about to head off to round up a bag full of the coolest souvenirs for CONY, you saw Cassandra looking like she has something she wants to say. You should talk to her.
QuestInfo.2:
It looks like Cassandra was the one who gave CONY the Maple Souvenir Collection list.
If a particular souvenir listed in the collection proves difficult to obtain, Cassandra has offered to hook you up with it in exchange for #b#t4036532# x50, which you can get from monsters near your level#k.
Something feels a liiiiittle bit off about that, but it's nice to have that option available in case you need it.
